description.value: Amsterdam Restaurant is a cozy, locally owned breakfast and lunch eatery that has been introducing Kamloops to Dutch pannenkoeken (crepes) for over 20 years. Its menu fuses North American favourites with European specialties including Belgian waffles, German Reuben, and Moroccan Chicken Shawarma, all made with fresh, locally sourced ingredients. Cyclists with dietary restrictions will find extensive gluten-free, vegan, and vegetarian options, and takeout is readily available for those on the move.
